welcome.headline: Promo Preflight
welcome.positioning: Deterministic pre-launch gate for regulated promo campaigns
welcome.body: One workspace and one REST contract for campaign intake, 8 deterministic checks, idempotent run persistence, audit events, Telegram alerts, version diff, and launch handoff.
welcome.ctaHint: Use a sample case to follow the visible path, then open System Status and API Contract to inspect the backend path.
welcome.workflowSubtitle: From campaign JSON to audit-proof launch handoff
welcome.proofStrip: REST API v1 · Idempotent runs · Postgres · Transactional outbox · Audit log · Telegram alerts · CI · 177 tests · Apache 2.0
welcome.architectureBody: The UI is only the front door. Each run goes through Zod validation, command bus dispatch, deterministic checks, Postgres persistence, outbox events, audit delivery, and best-effort Telegram notification.

architecture.title: System story
architecture.subtitle: How one campaign run moves through the system.
steps: A CampaignBundle enters through UI or POST /api/v1/runs and is validated at the boundary.
The deterministic engine runs channel, terms, math, GEO, localization, ownership, link, and format checks.
The command persists run, campaign version, blockers, and outbox rows in one Postgres transaction.
Idempotency keeps retries and double-clicks from creating duplicate work.
The worker drains outbox rows into audit_log first, then best-effort Telegram notification.
Campaigns, Risk Report, Handoff, Status, API Contract, and Evidence expose the same underlying state.
